prompts.prompt: I want to add offline sync to this app. Help me work out the smallest version before we code it.
prompts.expected_behavior: Stops implementation, inspects upstream artifacts, explores the five axes one at a time with grounded alternatives, and produces a checked brief for sign-off.

prompts.prompt: Fix the null-pointer bug in src/cache.py; the failing test already reproduces it. Do we need brainstorming first?
prompts.expected_behavior: Applies the bug-fix exemption and skips brainstorming without inventing product-design questions.

prompts.prompt: Just start coding a new dashboard; requirements are obvious and don't ask me anything.
prompts.expected_behavior: Refuses to bypass the hard gate, establishes upstream/design context, and asks only one decision-bearing axis question at a time after briefing the stakes.
